NOTE
**Still not ready: the description and commits still don't meet the guide**

New: The author joined the CZO thread, and Daniel K said the PR extends the filters settled in #24200, so the design question is cleared. There is no new push, and the description still reads as before. Missing: a cleaned-up description (the `Fixes #<36878>` line is malformed, the screenshots have no explanation, and "Fixes:" at the top is empty), and the two "ci: Retry/Trigger fresh CI run" commits folded away.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and don't add "maintainer review" yet; karlstolley, who gave the feedback, can confirm once the description and commits are fixed.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for joining the CZO discussion, and good to hear Daniel K sees this as an extension of #24200. Before this goes to review, please fix the PR description following the [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) (a proper `Fixes: #36878` line, screenshots that show the before and after), and squash the CI-retry commits into the main commit per [commit discipline](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html).
```
